title: Figure 20. Skeletal System with blue orb path across shoulders and spine
description: Two anatomical illustrations: a labeled front-view human skeleton (cranium, clavicle, scapula, sternum, rib, humerus, pelvis, femur, tibia, etc.) and a color-coded spinal column showing cervical, thoracic, lumbar and sacral nerves with vertebra labels. Each has a blue circle and leftward arrow marking an orb path at upper-chest/cervical level. Caption: "Figure 20. Skeletal System"; below is the heading "Unidentified Inflammatory Problem and Abnormal Laboratory Results" over a large 1843(a)(2) redaction box.
